title: Bounded decoding candidates
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let $T$ be a table of functions from the $q$-dimensional sign cube to $[-1,1]$, let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$, and fix a vertex $v$. The decoding candidates at $v$ are the union of the notable coordinates of $T(v)$ and the notable coordinates of its averaged neighbor function.
